summary: Part 1 is built as the intent describes, and nothing more or less. build_command takes a new optional basetemp param and adds --basetemp only when given; _exec passes tmp_dir/'t', a subdirectory of the unit temp, keeping the attempt log and JUnit report out of the wiped folder. Both the first attempt and retries go through _exec. run_test_suite.py is still exactly 529 lines (bloat exception held); F0.md is 362 lines (<400). The new test file covers the flag-only-when-given and subdir/JUnit-outside points. No gate is weakened. Parts 2/3 (deferred) and Part 4 (dropped) are not in the diff, as required. Outside spec scope: the retry reproduce command (line 357) is built without --basetemp; left for code-reviewer.
